title: Falling / Rising BG Threshold Alerts use mg/dl when mmol/l is set
symptom: The Falling / Rising BG Threshold Alert settings display values in mg/dl even when the user has set mmol/l as their unit of measurement.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It is suggested that the issue may be due to hardcoded UI labels rather than database units, but this is not confirmed.
fix: No fix is provided. The maintainer suggests closing the issue and notes that correcting the units would require code changes, but no resolution is implemented.
evidence_quote: It may be a problem with hardcoded UI labels rather than db units and such.
